title: Turkish Norms for the Objects-on-Hands Picture Database: Cross-Cultural Correspondence and Perceived Disease Risk as an Additional Normative Dimension (Rengiiyiler, Tekozel; OSF project created 2026-09-22)
licence: none stated on the OSF project (checked 2026-11-01 via the OSF API: license null). The release file is therefore not committed. Derived per-object means for the 72 objects this night used are committed in people.json as cited research results, with attribution; see the journal's rights note.

files.name: Turkish_Objects_on_Hands_Normative_Data.xlsx
files.what: Object-level Turkish norms (N = 107, two lists of 63 objects, about 53 raters per object): naming, familiarity 1-5, perceived disease risk 1-7 (1 = not at all risky, 7 = very risky), mean and SD per object. Sheet Turkish_Norms read. Not committed (no licence stated).

pictures: The 126 photographs belong to the Objects-on-Hands Picture Database (Fernandes et al. 2019, PLOS ONE, https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0219615; OSF https://osf.io/xn2u9/), available on request only. Not used: the makers and the face have the objects' English names, not the pictures.
